| Item | Current disposition |

These are the dispositions in doc 37. The passing tests do not establish typecheck, build, browser or database qualification.

## Two important limits on the eventual approvals

**A1 remains a protected-edit decision, not permission to make Quick Order operational.** The PWA overlay requires a separate protected change before intake, and the route/privacy regression tests must accompany the reviewed mount work. Do not silently turn the current six-file proposal into a seven-file authorization. 

**A2 needs the conditions from doc 36, not just the earlier file list.** In particular, the review warns against using the Research-use `early_access_terms/v1` document for this Health intake, and against introducing SQL objects that alter the provider fence’s fingerprint without addressing that dependency. It also states that the unresolved durable currentness authority is **outside A2’s listed scope**; its exact design/proposal is needed before the commit RPC body can be drafted as a reviewable implementation. Those are future drafting constraints, not authorization to start that work now.  

**The existing team can therefore make useful progress now on the two unprotected HTTP defects and packet corrections. A1, A2, GATE-01 and all live-intake/release decisions remain pending, with no need to ask you the same approval questions again in this update.**
